checks: All three presets validate, install, restart, and keep protected file modes
Max and edited curves use the same validated installation and recovery transaction
Quiet ≤ Balanced ≤ Cooler across CPU/GPU and palm ranges; full speed by 90°C chip or 40°C palm
Apple automatic stops and disables Cooler while preserving the profile
Validation/stop/start failures preserve configuration; failed startup leaves Apple automatic
Unknown actions are rejected by the plugin and by the passwordless helper
The helper takes only the three curve fields from the caller and rejects malformed values
A refused helper run reports failure and keeps the installed configuration unchanged
A refused custom edit reports failure to the editor and keeps the installed curve
Overlapping actions are serialized before the helper runs
